title: Independent review authentication predicate
description: Portable signature and provenance checks. Caller-supplied facts at the pure seam cannot establish ordinary trust authority.

host_result.description: Observed signed host result; its body is covered by the signature.

workspace_ref.description: Workspace identity observed by the host adapter.

now_unix_micros.description: Current host clock observation in Unix microseconds.

public_keys.description: Already-authoritative key facts for the pure host seam, or null for unchanged release-pinned keys. Never accepted by ordinary native ingress.
